bounds.domain: One runtime and room, one proof identity with a shared observer, two queued raw mutations, and room and topology generations 0 through 2. One create response can overlap deletion, topology change, or runtime replacement.
bounds.scope: Finite queue safety, conditional drain of a quarantined queue, and create-response safety. Real HTTP and file-backed SQLite scenario conformance.

assumptions: The raw mutation queue advances with weak fairness. A queued mutation reaches the head, and active database I/O can eventually return success or failure.
A quarantined queue rejects new entries. Progress does not imply a wall-clock bound or successful I/O.
No fairness is assumed. A timed-out observer can leave raw I/O in flight indefinitely.
